label: r1
issues: Proportions far too long and low — concept is a short, stubby chunky bus, render is a stretched van/tram shape
Wheels tiny, half-buried and barely visible; concept has big chunky black tyres with grey hubs standing proud
Body colour is pale cream/light yellow instead of bright school-bus yellow
Front hood section is thin and slab-like; missing the rounded chunky nose and orange grille slats
Headlights are small yellow studs instead of prominent round lamps; front bumper detail missing
Roof profile is a simple ribbed arch with an odd raised ridge; lacks the smooth curved-slope roof of concept
Black beltline stripe is inconsistent and interrupted; window band framing looks ragged
Windows are white/transparent plates reading as blank panels rather than dark glazed windows
Rear red lights oversized and stick out sideways; rear bumper/plate detail missing
Overall looks like a rough digital mockup, not a finished official LEGO set
distilled: A LEGO model of a chunky yellow school bus built from stacked bricks and plates, with a rounded roof, black-and-white striped bumpers, and four rolling wheels.
